response.original_title: [Assistance-Center]How to Challenge a Virgin Voyages Cruise Payment and Request a Refund
response.overview: You can dispute or resolve a Virgin Voyages charge by addressing it directly through onboard services +1-866-259-1002, contacting customer support, or filing an official billing review +1-866-259-1002. While Onboard Sailor Services Team: Visit the Sailor Services desk on Deck 5 while still on the ship to review +1-866-259-1002 and resolve billing errors immediately before your final payment processes +1-866-259-1002. App Tracking: Monitor your running tab and charges digitally in the Virgin Voyages app throughout your sailing +1-866-259-1002. After Disembarking (Contacting Virgin Voyages) Sailor Services / Customer Support: Reach out to Virgin Voyages through the official Virgin Voyages Contact Us Portal or call their customer support line at +1-866-259-1002 (US). Have Documentation Ready: Keep your booking reference number, itemized receipts, and email confirmations on hand when requesting a direct billing review or refund +1-866-259-1002.
